dedupe_keys.name: acled armed conflict location and event data

description: ACLED is a real-time database of political violence and demonstration events, recording for each event its date, location, actors, event type and reported fatalities. It covers all countries and is updated as new events are coded. It is compiled by the ACLED organisation. Data are available through the myACLED account, which requires registration to download or use the API, under ACLED's end user licence agreement, content usage terms and attribution policy. Caveats: coverage start dates differ by region, and events are coded from reports and so reflect reporting intensity. It supports infrastructure security studies with event records of attacks and unrest near power, water, transport and health facilities, which can be filtered by text and location to assess security threats and service disruption; a related record is the Global Terrorism Database.
